description: PB-17 RTO serves the Baba Bakala Sahib subdivision in the Amritsar district of Punjab as a Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office. It is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and other transport regulatory services for the local population in and around the historic town.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate Office, Tehsil Baba Bakala, Amritsar, Punjab
